How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics or Astronomy or equivalent disciplines with a minimum of 60% marks. Good computer programming skills are also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the General category is 30 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 30000-37000 per month plus 20% HRA. The exact amount depends on whether the candidate has qualified for GATE or NET.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their detailed CV and relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. Are GATE or NET qualifications mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: No, GATE or NET qualification is desirable but not essential. However, having these qualifications may affect the salary offered.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit a detailed CV, all relevant essential qualification degree certificates, marks sheets, GATE qualifying certificates (if applicable), and Date of Birth proof in a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
